data/txt/ja/gamedata/menu/title_menu_tex.1:2:
The king wants the Purple Eye for Princess
Melonia. Chup and friends must defeat
Madusa to get it. Can they come up with a
winning plan?
data/txt/ja/gamedata/menu/title_menu_tex.2:2:
Cinderella once led the elite Glass
Slipper unit. Now she is training Chup and
friends to defeat Madusa. Can they survive
her tough lessons?
data/txt/ja/gamedata/menu/title_menu_tex.3:2:
Chup and friends need better gear, but the
shopkeeper is away. Pinocchio gives them
terrible service! Can they still find a
bargain?
data/txt/ja/gamedata/menu/title_menu_tex.4:2:
A mysterious old woman sells the team a
magic lamp. Three genies emerge! Will
their magic help Chup and friends finally
defeat Madusa?
